description: I3B.a alert rules for the headless Marlin endpoint, evaluated by `python -m infrx.observe.alerts` (apps/infrx-api/infrx/observe/alerts.py documents the rule shape). Every metric is a family of infrx/observe/metrics.py FAMILIES. Thresholds are provisional engineering values - each rule's threshold_status says where the number comes from; none is a target or an SLO, and none has been measured on the target (P-18). 'page' = act now, 'ticket' = act within the working day.

rules.name: ComponentDown
rules.summary: A required component (engine, database, index, object store, journal, price source) failed its probe.
rules.threshold_status: exact: the gauge is 1 or 0

rules.name: GpuUnavailable
rules.summary: nvidia-smi did not answer: the engine cannot serve.
rules.threshold_status: exact: the gauge is 1 or 0

rules.name: DiskAlmostFull
rules.summary: A configured filesystem has less than 10% free (or cannot be read).
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): engineering floor; the trace spool refuses below 2 GiB free (infra/README.md §2), 10% of the 300 GiB root is 30 GiB

rules.name: DiskFilling
rules.summary: A configured filesystem has less than 20% free.
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): early warning at twice the page floor

rules.name: HostMemoryLow
rules.summary: Host memory available is below 10% of total.
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): engineering floor for the 61 GiB g6e.2xlarge (I1B inventory)

rules.name: QueueStalled
rules.summary: The oldest available index candidate has waited longer than an async job's queue budget.
rules.threshold_status: derived: QUEUE_WAIT_ASYNC_S = 600 (contracts limits); ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18) against the measured envelope

rules.name: QueueSaturated
rules.summary: The scheduling index is above 80% of its item cap.
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): fraction of MAX_INDEX_ITEMS (500)

rules.name: InflightSaturated
rules.summary: The gateway is at its in-flight limit: new requests are refused with 429.
rules.threshold_status: exact: at the configured MAX_INFLIGHT

rules.name: RejectionsHigh
rules.summary: More than 50 capacity/rate refusals since the last evaluation.
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): per evaluation interval (the timer's, 60 s proposed); the L3 burst cell of E1B measures what normal looks like

rules.name: PlatformFailureRate
rules.summary: Platform-caused failures exceed 1% of terminal jobs since the last evaluation.
rules.threshold_status: provisional (P-18): E1B protocol §4 error-rate criterion <1% platform-caused failures

rules.name: LeaseLost
rules.summary: A worker lost a lease (died, stalled or was fenced); the reaper recovered it.
rules.threshold_status: exact: any loss is a worker or host event worth a look

rules.name: ReaperTerminalized
rules.summary: The reaper settled jobs whose phase deadline passed (lost preparation, stalled generation).
rules.threshold_status: exact: each is a customer-visible failure

rules.name: ReconciliationDrift
rules.summary: A wallet total disagrees with its ledger or its active holds.
rules.threshold_status: exact: 0 is the only healthy value (R59-7)

rules.name: ReconciliationStale
rules.summary: No clean reconciliation pass for more than an hour.
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): the reconciler's cadence is Q3/D5's

rules.name: UnsettleableJobs
rules.summary: Overdue jobs the reaper could not settle: their holds stay reserved.
rules.threshold_status: exact

rules.name: UnknownUsageBacklog
rules.summary: More than 10 holds wait for unknown-usage reconciliation.
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): engineering guess; each is released at UNKNOWN_USAGE_RECONCILE_S (24 h)

rules.name: PreparationSlow
rules.summary: Mean preparation time since the last evaluation is above half its phase budget.
rules.threshold_status: derived: PREPARATION_TIMEOUT_S = 120 / 2; ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18)

rules.name: JournalSlow
rules.summary: Mean journal append time since the last evaluation is above 250 ms (cross-region RTT budget).
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): infra/README.md §3 journal-latency probe design; the hosted database is in us-east-2, the box in us-east-1

rules.name: SettlementSlow
rules.summary: Mean settlement time since the last evaluation is above 1 s.
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): engineering guess; one transaction over the pooler

rules.name: MetricsSanitizerRejections
rules.summary: A call site tried to write an undeclared label value or a bad number; the value was replaced with 'other'.
rules.threshold_status: exact: a code defect, never an operating condition
